description: Yelo - Disponibilité des vélos en libre-service is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'agglomération de La Rochelle. Yelo, Availability of self-service bikes. Coverage: Communauté d'agglomération de La Rochelle. The portal shows the English title as "Yelo — Availability of self-service bikes" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'agglomération de La Rochelle. Its keywords include place, velo. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
